propositions: Canonical contributor guidance in AGENTS.md and .agents/rules/rebar.md hardcodes a specific bot identity (joeoakhart+bot@navapbc.com) while CONTRIBUTING.md requires real contributor names for DCO sign-off, creating contradictory requirements.
Contributor-facing documentation must be made identity-neutral to instruct actors to sign off with their own configured git identity rather than a hardcoded third-party identity.
A deterministic lint-time consistency check must be added to prevent reintroduction of hardcoded personal sign-offs in contributor-facing guidance files.

The check must scan AGENTS.md, .agents/rules/*.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, and docs/**/*.md (excluding docs/experiments/) for hardcoded bot identities while excluding infra/, .github/workflows/, and tests/ which legitimately reference the bot.
